```{python}
from render import make_shock_regression_table, make_regression_table
from specs import (
    jobloss,
    coal_shock,
    coal_shock_panel,
    fuel_shock,
    fuel_shock_panel,
    palm_shock,
    palm_shock_panel,
    update_formula_search_replace,
    MAIN_TEMP_MEASURE,
)

main_shock_specs = [palm_shock, fuel_shock, coal_shock, jobloss]
panel_shock_specs = [palm_shock_panel, fuel_shock_panel, coal_shock_panel]
shock_groups = [
    "palm_farmer_hh_ifls4",
    "urban_vehicle_hh_ifls4",
    "coal_worker_hh_ifls4",
    "job_loss_1_yr",
]
shock_posts = ["ifls5", "post_subsidy", "ifls5", None]

shock_groups_panel = shock_groups[:-1]
shock_posts_panel = shock_posts[:-1]
```

# Main Effects

## Main Table

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Daily Mean

```{python}
main_shock_daily_mean = [
    update_formula_search_replace(spec, MAIN_TEMP_MEASURE, "tmean_c_dev")
    for spec in main_shock_specs
]
make_shock_regression_table(
    main_shock_specs,
    group=shock_groups,
    post=shock_posts,
    temperature="tmean_c_dev",
)
```

### 7-day mean

```{python}
main_shock_7_day = [
    update_formula_search_replace(spec, MAIN_TEMP_MEASURE, "tmean_7d_dev")

]
make_shock_regression_table(
    main_shock_7_day,
    group=shock_groups,
    post=shock_posts,
    temperature="tmean_7d_dev",
)
```

# Robustness

## Job Loss 

```{python}
jobloss_windows = [
    ("3 mo", "job_loss_90d"),
    ("6 mo", "job_loss_180d"),
    ("9 mo", "job_loss_270d"),
    ("1 yr", "job_loss_1_yr"),
    ("18 mo", "job_loss_540d"),
    ("2 yr", "job_loss_730d"),
    ("36 mo", "job_loss_1095d"),
    ("5 yr", "job_loss_1825d"),
]
jobloss_robustness_specs = [
    update_formula_search_replace(jobloss, "job_loss_1_yr", job_loss_var)
    for _, job_loss_var in jobloss_windows
]
rename_dict = {job_loss_var: f"Job Loss" for label, job_loss_var in jobloss_windows}
# Append
rename_dict[MAIN_TEMP_MEASURE] = "Heat"
make_regression_table(
    jobloss_robustness_specs,
    rename=rename_dict,
    keep=["Job Loss", "Heat", "Job Loss:Heat"],
    titles=[f"{label}" for label, _ in jobloss_windows],
)
```
